items.title: Mortgage Rates Waiting on the Jobs Report for Their Next Move
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Well, we got a tame PCE report this morning, which would normally be good news for mortgage rates. items.title: Mortgage Rates Could Top Out at 8.88% If History Repeats
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: If you’ve ever looked at a mortgage rate chart, you’ll see that mortgage rates experienced a double-top in the early 1980s. That’s when mortgage rates hit all-time highs, with the 30-year fixed briefly rising above 18%. items.title: Rocket Mortgage Making the Switch From FICO to VantageScore
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Rocket Mortgage announced today that it will soon default to VantageScore 4.0 instead of the FICO score it relied upon for years. items.title: What Can Save Mortgage Rates?

items.title: What’s Next for Mortgage Rates?  7.50%? 8%?

items.content: Now that mortgage rates are the highest they’ve been since early 2025, the next logical question is how high will they go? How high do mortgage rates go this cycle? items.title: Mortgage Rates Now Highest Since Trump Took Office
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Just when it appeared that mortgage rates were chipping away, they’re back to new highs. And not just any old highs, but the highest highs since President Trump took office for his second term.
